reasons.badPercent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, for example 7,5.
reasons.badAmount: Enter an amount such as 95 or 95,50.
reasons.badQuantity: Enter a quantity above 0 with at most three decimals, for example 2,5.
reasons.badRate: Enter a VAT rate from 0 to 100, for example 19.
reasons.offerNoPeriod: An offer has no service period.
reasons.periodFromRequired: Enter the start of the service period first.
reasons.periodOrder: The end must not be before the start.
reasons.validUntilOffer: Only an offer has a validity date.
reasons.discountExclusive: Use a percentage or an amount, not both.
reasons.rateRange: The value must be between 0 and 100.
reasons.negative: The value must not be negative.
reasons.kleinunternehmerRate: Under the Kleinunternehmer regime the VAT rate is 0.
reasons.exemptLine: A line without VAT needs an exemption reason under the standard regime. That is not supported yet.
reasons.noCatalogueItem: This catalogue item does not exist.
reasons.invalidRegime: Choose the standard regime or the Kleinunternehmer regime.
reasons.wrongType: The value has the wrong type.
reasons.taxNumberRequired: A tax number or VAT ID is required in the seller profile.
reasons.servicePeriodRequired: An invoice needs a service date.
reasons.regimeUnknown: No VAT regime applies today. Choose one.
